## Hi, I'm Tiffany!

Welcome to my portfolio! Here, you will find a collection of projects that I have 
enjoyed wroking on, a list of my skills and areas of expertise, and a few fun
facts about me!

I came to data science from a Public Health background. I started unviersity interested 
in how we can navigate and address many of the disparities that are seen within our
systems. After taking a Introduction to Data Science course, I realized that data science 
is a powerful tool for telling the stories of our communities, informing decision making 
and bringing about change to our systems. 

At Willamette my focus has been engaging communities with data and identifying how data can 
be used to visualize disparities to inform decsion-making. My [capstone](capstone.qmd) is where that comes
together.
